newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler April international sales up 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler April international sales up 14 pct.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said its international vehicle sales in April rose 14 percent over a year earlier of 19,760 units.
Calendar year-to-date results are up seven percent over last year at 75,361 units, Chrysler said. The international sales include those outside of the United States, Canada and Mexico.
Chrysler said its European sales in April totaled 9,269 units, up seven percent over last year. Asia/Pacific sales totaled 5,300 units.
The largest sales growth came from Chrysler's Latin America region with sales of 3,901 units, a monthly record for the region and a 236 percent increase over April of last year.
Local production in Venezuela of Neon sedans and Jeep Cherokees and Grand Cherokees have significantly boosted sales in that country by more than 300 percent from a year ago, Chrysler said.
